shapes.label: IdeaMesh   Cooker · Mesh · Integration
shapes.desc: Same top bar, with Integration selected.

shapes.label: Test idea: 2026-11-26-idea-mesh
shapes.desc: Picks which idea is sent through the chain. It defaults to the latest idea in the repo.

shapes.label: Run full chain
shapes.desc: Runs every live and prototype brick end to end on the chosen idea and pushes the results, just like a real run. During the run it turns into 'Stop', and it is disabled when no brick has cleared its checks.

shapes.label: Last full run: 3 of 4 bricks passed · 14:02
shapes.desc: Summary of the latest chain run. Before any run it says 'Not run yet'.

shapes.label: Chain
shapes.desc: The bricks in run order (Ideas repo, Portfolio + text, Website · local folder, with PassRotor indented under the repo), each with its ring colour, its time and a '!' icon if it failed. Selecting a brick shows its output in #6.

shapes.label: Output view
shapes.desc: Like Idea Cooker's prototype view: what the selected brick actually produced, side by side with the next brick's input.

shapes.label: Repo folder · Portfolio entry · Local website
shapes.desc: Tabs that jump between the three outputs of the chain. The tab for the selected brick is highlighted.

shapes.label: Live preview
shapes.desc: Renders the output: the README for the repo folder, the portfolio entry as it will look, and the local website page in a sandboxed frame. While a brick is running it shows a loading state, and for a failed brick it shows the error.

shapes.label: Hand-off checks
shapes.desc: For each connection: did the brick's output match what the next brick takes in, and the result of each check layer. A failed row says what was missing.

shapes.label: Rerun brick
shapes.desc: Reruns only the selected brick with the input it had last time. It is disabled while a run is in progress.

shapes.label: Open folder
shapes.desc: Opens the selected brick's local output folder in Explorer.

note: Integration page: pick a test idea and run the full chain at the top, the chain of bricks on the left, and the output view with live previews and hand-off checks on the right. Decide whether a full-chain test should really push, or write to a scratch branch.
